strings.subtitle: — Umwipaya wa mafailo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ukukoka no kuleka takuli. Bomfya button na panshi.
strings.ssd_warning:
Ishibilo! Pa SSD, inshila ya ukulemba pa ntanshi tayafwaya ukuponya pa mulandu wa TRIM.
Programu iyi ni ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifailo "{name}" likalembwa pa ntanshi no kufutwa.

Kontinua?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  IFAILO LYALEMBWA PA NTANSHI NO KUFUTWA
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS imilongo imbi ya data (ADS) tayabombwa.
• Ibuluku lya USN talisukululwa.
• Ifikope fya cinshi ne sinkulaisa ya pa mitambo
  (OneDrive na fimbi) tafikwatilwe.
strings.status_full: Ifyaba mukati fyonse fyabembwa pa ntanshi ne sero. Ukubwelela takwaba — ifibomfya fikamona sero fye.
strings.status_fast: Umutwe, umuchila ne milongo 4 MB fyabembwa pa ntanshi. Fimbi tafyakwatilwe, lelo pa mulandu wa mpanta, ukubwelela konse na fibomfya fya ba consumers takwakwatilwa. Pa makalata ya inshita bomfya umusango ONSE.
strings.status_empty: Ifailo lyali ubwafya, ukulemba pa ntanshi takwakwatilwe. Lyafutwa.
strings.error_permission: Tawakwata ukufika ku failo. Kuti lyaisulwa mu programu imbi. Isala, susuka kabili.
strings.error_is_symlink: Ici ni cilungo ca cishibilo. Ifilungo tafikwatilwa ukuponywa — ifailo lya kufika likasala bwino.
strings.error_reparse: Ici ni failo lya mpita (OneDrive nangu ifyo). Ifyaba mukati fyaba mu mitambo, te pa disk — kuno takuli cipona.
strings.error_not_file: Ici te failo (foda nangu cimbi). Koka ifailo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Ifailo ili likwete ifilungo fikosa fimbi ({n} fyonse). Ifilungo fikosa tafikwete umukalamba — amashina yonse yalingana. Nga waponya mu nshila ya nomba, data ikalembwa pa ntanshi no kutemwa ku 32 byte, lelo cishaleko cikaba cifikilwa mu filungo fimbi. Ponya ifilungo fyonse kubunsa.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifailo lyakankalwa, lyafisama nangu ni lyapungu. Ukulemba ne sero takufwaya ukuponya data ya kale pantu NTFS ibika mu nshila imbi.

Fumya umusango: klik ku kulyo → Ifyo pali → Ifitamfya → fumya icishibilo kuli "Kankala" na/nangu "Fisa". Kabili bomfya SHREDDER kabili.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Amafyali {count} yakuonwa.
Umwale: {size}.

Lolesha list bwe lwakwe.
Ichi tacikonkwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Fyeni amafyali yonse {count}?

Amafyali yene tayafywa — list ne.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" ilina hard links ({nlink} yonse).

Data yakuonwa ku menso yonse.
Lelo 32 bytes yasala mu menso imbi.

Munga no fyeni iyi yasala.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Bomfi kuli hard links yonse mu queue
